verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's agent feature lets users describe what they need in natural language, and the AI agent searches, navigates and retrieves it without URLs, with adjustable reasoning effort. Structured extraction also accepts a natural-language prompt, and the MCP server and coding-agent skills let users drive Firecrawl through conversational AI tools. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the agent's natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, and evidence of natural-language control beyond the agent and extract features without relying on a third-party AI client.
